077025 SPC is listed as a special non-contributory benefit for the purposes of EC law 1. Such benefits are
only payable in, and at the expense of, the State in which the person is habitually resident. This means
that SPC is payable in the UK only and EC law does not permit export of this benefit to claimants living
abroad.

Concept role: dwp:Applicability.","text":"DMG 77035 distinguishes new claims from 15 May 2019 and continuity protection linked to Pension Credit or pension-age Housing Benefit on 14 May 2019. DMG 77140–77184 distinguish the mixed-age definition, Universal Credit interaction, excluded-partner exceptions and effective dates. The general exclusion is not the complete rule. DMG memo 04/24 paragraphs 15–17 add a protected mixed-age migration route from 8 June 2024: the specified protected couples sent a migration notice may reclaim pension-age Housing Benefit or claim Pension Credit within three months after the relevant UC or HB award ends.
